title.zh: 在所识之中的识：以所读者为索引的识恰在没有差别处完备；补全它是从不封闭、从不返回、不被有限储存持有的展开；说谎者是没有静值的节律
title.en: A registration within what it registers: a registration indexed by what it reads is complete exactly where nothing differs; completing it is an unfolding that never closes, never returns and is held by no finite stock; the liar is a rhythm with no still value

claim.zh: 设 ψ : A → A → B 是以所读者为索引的识，same 是值的相同。ψ 说出读法 g（Diagonal.Says same ψ g），指某个 a 使 ∀ x，same (ψ a x) (g x)；缺口 gap f ψ x = f (ψ x x)；f 移动每个值（Diagonal.Moves same f），指 ∀ b，¬ same b (f b)。f 移动每个值时，没有成员说出缺口（Diagonal.gap_unsaid）；说出每个读法的 ψ 给每个 f 一个值 b 使 same b (f b)（Diagonal.fixed_of_complete）。主张从不与它的否定相同（Diagonal.moves_not），所以没有主张族 ψ : A → A → Prop 说出每个读法（Diagonal.claims_incomplete、Diagonal.claims_gap），没有框架以自己的配置实现关于配置的每种主张模式（Frame.self_incomplete）。以相等比较的值：与一个值的相等可判定时，完备的 ψ 推出值都相等（Diagonal.alike_of_complete）；值都相等时有完备的 ψ（Diagonal.complete_of_alike）；值的相等可判定时，完备恰当值都相等（Diagonal.complete_iff_alike）。φ : ℕ → A → A → B 展开（Diagonal.Unfolds same f φ），指它保留所说出的，并在下一步说出该步的缺口；f 移动每个值时，它在每一步都不完备（Diagonal.Unfolds.incomplete），第 m + k 步的缺口在第 m 步不被说出（Diagonal.Unfolds.gap_new），same 可传递时没有两个缺口相同（Diagonal.Unfolds.gaps_differ），从不返回（Diagonal.Unfolds.never_returns），same 对称、可传递时没有有限储存持有它的缺口（Diagonal.stock_unheld、Diagonal.Unfolds.unheld）。Bool 上存在这样的展开（Diagonal.unfolding、Diagonal.unfolding_unfolds、Diagonal.unfolding_open）。以移动每个值的 f 修正值，Law.orbit f b (n + 1) ≠ Law.orbit f b n（Diagonal.revision_never_rests）；以否定修正主张，在 Iff 之下从不静止（Diagonal.denial_never_rests）；二值的否定每两步返回（Diagonal.denial_returns）。不用 Lean 公理。
claim.en: Let ψ : A → A → B be a registration indexed by what it reads, and same the likeness of values. ψ says a reading g (Diagonal.Says same ψ g) when some a has ∀ x, same (ψ a x) (g x); the gap is gap f ψ x = f (ψ x x); f moves every value (Diagonal.Moves same f) when ∀ b, ¬ same b (f b). Where f moves every value no member says the gap (Diagonal.gap_unsaid); a ψ saying every reading gives every f a value b with same b (f b) (Diagonal.fixed_of_complete). A claim is never alike with its negation (Diagonal.moves_not), so no family of claims ψ : A → A → Prop says every reading (Diagonal.claims_incomplete, Diagonal.claims_gap), and no frame realizes with its own configurations every pattern of claims about them (Frame.self_incomplete). For values compared by equality: with equality to one value decided, a complete ψ makes all values equal (Diagonal.alike_of_complete); where all values are equal some ψ is complete (Diagonal.complete_of_alike); with equality of values decidable, completeness is exactly all values being equal (Diagonal.complete_iff_alike). φ : ℕ → A → A → B unfolds (Diagonal.Unfolds same f φ) when it keeps what it says and next says the step's gap; where f moves every value it is incomplete at every step (Diagonal.Unfolds.incomplete), the gap of step m + k is not said at step m (Diagonal.Unfolds.gap_new), with same transitive no two gaps are alike (Diagonal.Unfolds.gaps_differ), it never returns (Diagonal.Unfolds.never_returns), and with same symmetric and transitive no finite stock holds its gaps (Diagonal.stock_unheld, Diagonal.Unfolds.unheld). Such an unfolding exists on Bool (Diagonal.unfolding, Diagonal.unfolding_unfolds, Diagonal.unfolding_open). Revising a value by an f moving every value, Law.orbit f b (n + 1) ≠ Law.orbit f b n (Diagonal.revision_never_rests); revising a claim by negation never rests up to Iff (Diagonal.denial_never_rests); the two-valued denial returns every two steps (Diagonal.denial_returns). No Lean axiom is used.

hypotheses.zh: 不加前提：gap_unsaid、claims_incomplete、Unfolds 的各条与节律对每个族、每个值的类型与每个“相同”成立。
hypotheses.en: No premise: gap_unsaid, claims_incomplete, the laws of Unfolds and the rhythm hold for every family, type of values and likeness.

hypotheses.zh: 局部条件写在定理之中：alike_of_complete 要与一个值的相等可判定，complete_iff_alike 要值的相等可判定，gaps_differ 要 same 可传递，stock_unheld 要它对称、可传递（只在自然数下标上判定）。
hypotheses.en: Local conditions are written into the theorems: alike_of_complete needs equality with one value decided, complete_iff_alike needs equality of values decidable, gaps_differ needs same transitive, stock_unheld needs it symmetric and transitive (deciding only on natural-number indices).

hypotheses.zh: 识是以所读者为索引的族，这是给出的读法；算术编码与可证性没有陈述。
hypotheses.en: A registration is a family indexed by what it reads, a supplied reading; arithmetic coding and provability are not stated.

correspondence.zh: P71（工作板），按 Ren 2026-10-12 的“push the frontier, as far as possible”。外围 RootCoverageBoundary（数学抽象，CoverageBoundary.lean，导入 Std）有同一对角线的函数与谓词形式（fixed_point_of_complete、diagonal_extension_strict）；这里在核心中不用公理重述，并加上完备恰在没有差别处、补全的展开与节律。检验 Ren 的推测中“从内部”的一半：任何给定的真可以在下一步说出，不能从一个情境全部说出，限制在投影。P70 以 revision_never_rests 推出否定的两个状态（Denial.two_states）。读法（AI 的，待 Ren；Ren 同意了包含它们的回答）：庄子的“一与言为二，二与一为三”有 Unfolds 的回退形式；宣布进循环的自我预测没有静止的对；早先把道可道读作“说不尽”是 AI 的读法，不是 Ren 的。见整合文档 §95。
correspondence.en: P71 (work board), following Ren's “push the frontier, as far as possible” of 12 October 2026. The periphery's RootCoverageBoundary (mathematical abstraction, CoverageBoundary.lean, importing Std) has the function and predicate forms of the same diagonal (fixed_point_of_complete, diagonal_extension_strict); here it is restated in the core with no axiom, with completeness exactly where nothing differs, the completing unfolding and the rhythm added. It tests the “from within” half of Ren's speculation: any given truth can be said at the next step, not all from one situation, and the limit is the projection's. P70 reads the denial's two states off revision_never_rests (Denial.two_states). Readings (the AI's, pending Ren; Ren agreed with the reply containing them): Zhuangzi's 一与言为二，二与一为三 has the regress form of Unfolds; a self-prediction announced into its loop has no still right value; the earlier reading of 道可道 as “说不尽” was the AI's, not Ren's. See §95 of the integration note.

detail.zh: 复用 Law.orbit、Law.Returns 与 gap_of_lt：修正是轨道，否定的返回是 Returns；补全的展开像保留的历史一样从不返回。
detail.en: Reuses Law.orbit, Law.Returns and gap_of_lt: revision is an orbit and the denial's return is Returns; the completing unfolding, like a kept history, never returns.

detail.zh: P70 从同一节律读出否定恰有两个状态。
detail.en: P70 reads the denial's exactly two states off the same rhythm.

detail.zh: 另一种投影的限制：不依语境的值；这里是从内部持有每个读法。
detail.en: Another limit of projection: context-free values; here, holding every reading from within.

detail.zh: 它的 diagonal_refutes 与 diagonal_unrested 是学习者的形式，与 gap_unsaid、revision_never_rests 同形而对象不同，各自写成。
detail.en: Its diagonal_refutes and diagonal_unrested are the learner's form, of the same form as gap_unsaid and revision_never_rests and a different object, written independently.

detail.zh: Bool 上的展开（unfolding_open）：每一步都不完备，从不返回，没有有限储存持有其缺口；二值否定的修正从不静止（revision_never_rests、flip_moves）。
detail.en: The unfolding on Bool (unfolding_open): incomplete at every step, never returning, its gaps held by no finite stock; revising the two-valued denial never rests (revision_never_rests, flip_moves).

limitations.zh: 识以所读者为索引；哥德尔的不完备与停机问题没有陈述；完备恰在没有差别处只对以相等比较、可判定的值，对主张只有从不完备；节律只对二值的否定是周期的；读法是 AI 的；不含伦理谓词。
limitations.en: Registrations are indexed by what they read; Gödel's incompleteness and the halting problem are not stated; completeness exactly where nothing differs is for values compared by decidable equality, and for claims only incompleteness is stated; the rhythm is periodic only for the two-valued denial; the readings are the AI's; contains no ethical predicate.

validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器成功实查（20261013T093441.881086Z）：Becoming.Diagonal 的 26 项定理全部空依赖，其中含 Diagonal.gap_unsaid、Diagonal.fixed_of_complete、Diagonal.claims_incomplete、Frame.self_incomplete、Diagonal.complete_iff_alike、Diagonal.Unfolds.incomplete、Diagonal.Unfolds.gaps_differ、Diagonal.Unfolds.never_returns、Diagonal.Unfolds.unheld、Diagonal.unfolding_open、Diagonal.revision_never_rests与 Diagonal.denial_returns；同一回执覆盖包内 75 个模块（含只作导入的根模块与桥接），共 4513 项定理／6364 项声明审计，22 个继承模块的当前字节与已通过回执一致；外围回执 20261013T093542.175797Z 通过。检查器另核对核心纯净：核心（GenerativeCore、InquirySufficiency、RelationalRenewal、L1–L4 与根模块 Becoming）的导入闭包恰为这 77 个模块，其中每条源声明的公理报告为空（Lean 生成的常量中，只有带字段构造子的单射引理 injEq 依赖 propext，没有源声明使用它们，检查器逐一列出），并且只用 Lean 内置前导即可编译（基础模块的 import Std 在该次编译中去掉）。作者反审见整合文档 §95；独立审查的范围见同节。
validation_scope.en: Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261013T093441.881086Z): the 26 theorems of Becoming.Diagonal all have empty axiom reports, among them Diagonal.gap_unsaid, Diagonal.fixed_of_complete, Diagonal.claims_incomplete, Frame.self_incomplete, Diagonal.complete_iff_alike, Diagonal.Unfolds.incomplete, Diagonal.Unfolds.gaps_differ, Diagonal.Unfolds.never_returns, Diagonal.Unfolds.unheld, Diagonal.unfolding_open, Diagonal.revision_never_rests and Diagonal.denial_returns; the same receipt covers the package's 75 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 4513 theorems/6364 declaration audits, and 22 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts; periphery receipt 20261013T093542.175797Z passed. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The author's counterreview is in §95 of the integration note, with the scope of the independent review.

next_delta.zh: 与外围 RootCoverageBoundary 的实例定理；与 P73 的 diagonal（没有学习者在每个历程上静止）的实例定理；Ren 的判断：从内部不能一次全部说出的读法。
next_delta.en: The instance theorem to the periphery's RootCoverageBoundary; the instance theorem to P73's diagonal (no learner rests on every course); Ren's judgment on the reading that from within not all can be said at once.
